run_prepro_dic_anet: run the ActivityNet dictionary preprocessing script to build vocab and caption JSON files
build_vocab_function: build a vocabulary from video segment tokens filtering by word count threshold
create_word_to_detection_map: create a word to detection label mapping from the ActivityNet class vocabulary
generate_word_lemmas: generate word lemmas using Stanford CoreNLP for each vocabulary word
output_preprocessed_json: output preprocessed dictionary and caption JSON files for ActivityNet video segments
